I want everyone in the world to remember "Aston Machan."
I want to leave behind a trace.

(If so, what form does "Aston Machan"
take inside everyone's minds?)

Aston Machan speaks while gazing steadily at me.
Pondering with soft hums, looking at the sky and then at the sea.

If you forget, we'll open the sachet together.
If we do that, you'll surely remember.

But, I found another wish.
It just popped up. Eheh.

Hearing that, I finally understood
what Aston Machan had put inside.

Whether you remembered properly,
is something I want to ask the Trainer of the far-off future.

...Daily records. Lap times, stride cadence, little habits,
down to things Machan never even noticed.

What kind of face the present Machan was making.
What kind of color Trainer held.
Ah, look. The flowers are blooming.

To be honest, I hadn't really thought about putting anything specific inside.
It didn't even necessarily have to be scented—
There is. I'm putting it in right now.

Her growth is tangible. Compared with past data,
one could say her progress is thoroughly satisfying.

Finding Aston Machan's unusually blank expression endearing,
I reply cheerfully.

...This is the Aston Machan
that Trainer remembers...
Let's check again in the distant future. Okay?

Remembering the sachet I gave her before, I ask.
Did she put anything inside it?
So very, very many have been left behind.
Yes.
Every day, a new me...

From this angle, you can't see the flowers on the sea~.
Though I'm sure you could see them from beneath the surface. Yes, surely.

What shall we put inside?
What kind of scent should it have?
Into something else.

(Ah. That, that feels like...
something far deeper than mere remembering—)

Summer training camp. Wrapping up a day of training,
I carefully log Aston Machan's records for today.

Folding it to put it inside won't do.
Photographs are always best kept as they are.

Trainer.
Please keep remembering plenty of the future Machan too.

...Hmm? But if we do that, it'll turn into a bag of memories.
We should definitely add a scent too.

The me of today. The me of tomorrow. The parts of me the world cannot fully capture,
reflected through Trainer's lens, preserved.

We'll search together. Just like today's memories,
for a warm, crystal-clear, vivid fragrance.

Trainer, look at the sky. Flowers will bloom in the sky very soon.
And when they do, blossoms will open across the sea as well.

Let's go. To the place we will reach someday.
For now, let us just watch.
Shh, keep it a secret.

That's why every time I look at this sachet, I'll remember.
This time that belongs only to Machan and you.
Eheh.

...My lens is vibrant right now.
Just like the sea reflecting the sky.
(So many different versions of "Aston Machan")

It's much cooler than during the daytime~.
And so very quiet. I feel like I can hear the sound of the waves so clearly.

Breaking the silence, the roar of fireworks echoes.
Their light reflects across the sea, shimmering brilliantly.

(If "I" change day by day, then for every time I am reflected
and remembered, that many versions of "me" will remain)
feels so vivid, doesn't it?

Listening to the sound of the waves, I gaze at the sea with Aston Machan.
Even without conversation there is no awkwardness, and we simply drift in thought for a while, but—

I haven't put anything inside yet.
But I always carry it with me. Even right now.

The time spent pondering what to put inside, the time spent watching the fireworks—
I've remembered every single bit of it.

Trainer. Talking with Mr. Computer, are we... hmm?
Are these Machan's records?
